title: Accept the tidy quarantine criterion correction
problem: The Action's #735 criterion still describes the archive-tag recovery mechanism that quarantine deliberately replaced, so the Action cannot truthfully be completed even though #739 and #740 are already covered by durable safety tests.
desired_effect: Accept only the reviewed Plan amendment that replaces #735 with the current run-scoped quarantine-ref and tidy-undo recovery truth, preserving #739 and #740 unchanged.

does: Validate the exact Ask SHA-256, pinned semantic envelope, primary pmark/arcadia main checkout, synchronized origin/main, inherited reviewed base, and unchanged Project, Plan, pointer, queue, and Action status

Use shared arcadia-plan-amendment-v1 to preview the exact settlement at click time, validate only the pinned #735 replacement and preserved #739/#740 criteria, then apply that fresh fingerprint and retain durable receipts
Push only Arcadia's exact accepted main-branch settlement after all pinned preconditions match
never_does: Run tidy, retire or restore a worktree or branch, change the queue, pointer, active Plan, Action status, or any Action other than the exact reviewed criterion replacement
Merge or deploy, activate production, press a Grant, start, stop, or restart services, use credentials, or settle any other proposal or Decision

success.effect: The Action remains open with a truthful #735 criterion and unchanged #739/#740 safety requirements; the exact settlement is committed and published on main with a durable receipt.
success.next: Use the existing tidy safety evidence to complete the Action only after its amended acceptance criteria are verified; this button itself does not run tidy or mark the Action done.

failure.effect: No unvalidated or broadened governance change is made. If settlement succeeded before push failed, the receipt remains durable and the same request can recover publication without a second settlement.
failure.next: Read the reason, changed field, and recovery instruction shown on /runs. Restore the named precondition and retry this exact action; do not substitute a proposal or alter #739/#740.
